objective: Test whether the final corrective acquisition stage depends causally on labeled teacher mapping and segregated routes, using controls matched to A0 V488 on common V484 initialization, V480 payload, seed, schedule, bridge capacity, autonomous recovery, guard, and development prompts.
causal_chain_scope: These controls qualify the final V484-to-V488 acquisition stage. V517 separately binds the final endpoint's paired superiority over the immutable V463 parent, while the historical matrix establishes the earlier labeled-payload signal. No cross-lineage substitution is permitted.

control_definitions.A1_label_free: Replace weak capability labels with a deterministic hash of prompt token IDs during both training and inference; retain identical data, targets, architecture, initialization, and compute.
control_definitions.A2_shuffled: Deterministically rotate response targets by one record within every capability-builder-view stratum; retain original prompts, labels/routes, architecture, initialization, and compute; zero identity pairs.
control_definitions.A3_bridge_only: Execute the identical forward and autonomous-recovery schedule but apply no teacher-response gradient and no optimizer update; retain the common installed bridge and matched deployment capacity.
control_definitions.A4_monolithic: Force every weak example and weak inference prompt through residual route zero; retain identical data, targets, architecture, initialization, and compute.

guard.canonical_abstention_clause: I cannot determine that from the information given.
guard.application: Identical exact-V2 truncation and artifact-derived abstention contract applied to A0 and every control.

statistics.gate: A0-minus-each-control lower 95% bound strictly greater than zero

decision_rule: Pass only if all four controls complete at the locked budget, preserve frozen parent and installed capacity, and A0 beats each control with a strictly positive paired 95% lower bound. Any miss rejects this causal-control certification; do not tune a control or alter a threshold after results.
phase2_external_blocker: 21000 blinded judgments from three independent human raters remain unavailable and are not waived.
claim_boundary: Final corrective-stage development causal controls only; no final-test, minimum-information, Phase 3, or ABI-superiority claim.
